node.label: Daniel Roche
node.date_label: Le Peuple de Paris (1981) · La Culture des apparences (1989) · Histoire des choses banales (1997)
node.description: Historian of Enlightenment France whose studies of clothing, possessions and everyday practices connected material culture to social differentiation. In dialogue with Gil Bartholeyns, Roche insists that representations require attention to their production, circulation and unequal reception. His consumption history examines changing needs and access to goods rather than treating objects as isolated curiosities.
